subject: Corner podium branding orientation and load-in window
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Event Operations <venue@skylineexpos.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Oct 2029 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Corner podium branding orientation and load-in window

Hi Liam / Event Ops team,

We're finalizing the booth layout for Redwood at Skyline Expo (booth H12). A couple of items we need to confirm before we lock prints and crate manifests: 

- Loading/window: Our crate ETA is show-day morning; can you confirm whether H12 uses curbside bay 06C or the west dock? We anticipate a 9'x6' crate and need a 10-12 minute unload slot.
- Power & AV: Where is the nearest floor power drop relative to the corner podium? We'll be placing two demo PCs and a low-profile monitor on the podium.
- Hero banner orientation: We're proposing a 12ft x 3ft horizontal hero behind the podium (low, over the demo counter). If horizontal headers aren’t permitted due to rigging, would a pair of vertical 3.3ft x 8ft flanking banners be acceptable instead?
- ADA / sightlines: Any mandatory clearance from the main aisle for podiums? We're aiming to keep sightlines open to adjacent inline booths.

Attaching our current floorplan draft (floorplan_draft_v2.pdf) and the crate manifest we're planning to ship (crate_manifest_q3.csv). If H12 is a problem for heavy curbside unload, please propose nearest available corner slot (we prefer corner but can accept adjacent inline with a sightline note).

Can we get confirmation and any constraints/requirements by EOD tomorrow? We have signage proofs going to vendor next week.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Attachments: floorplan_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), crate_manifest_q3.csv (CSV, 8KB)

From: Liam Foster <liam.foster@skylineexpos.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Event Operations <venue@skylineexpos.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Oct 2029 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Corner podium branding orientation and load-in window

Hi Priya — thanks for the detail. Quick answers below: 

- Loading/window: H12 is served by curbside bay 06C; standard unload window is 08:00–09:00 show morning. If you need a longer slot we can reserve 08:00–08:20 but it requires pre-registration for a freight elevator if your crate needs dolly access.
- Power & AV: The nearest floor power whip is ~5ft behind the podium on the left (we show it as PWR-13 on the plan). If you need an additional run we can schedule an electrician onsite but there is an extra charge and 48h lead.
- Hero banner orientation: The official rigging limit for that run is 8ft vertical height for banners located outside of structural truss zones. A full 12ft horizontal band is not permitted on that particular back wall due to ceiling grid constraints. Vertical 8ft banners or a low-profile 3ft header mounted at countertop height are workable. 
- ADA / sightlines: You must maintain a min 36" clearance in front of podiums; keep demo tables no closer than 3ft to the main aisle.

I've annotated your floorplan and attached it (floorplan_annotated_by_skyline.pdf). If H12's curbside timing won't work for your shipping schedule, G15 is the closest alternate corner with a morning unload window as well.

Let me know if you want me to tentatively hold H12 for 24 hours while you confirm with your vendor.

Best,
Liam Foster
Senior Exhibit Coordinator
Skyline Expos
liam.foster@skylineexpos.com | +1 206-555-0146

--
Attachments: floorplan_annotated_by_skyline.pdf (PDF, 870KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Thanks Liam — this is helpful. A couple internal notes and asks (cc'd Alex to coordinate sign vendor):

> On Mon, 14 Oct 2029 at 11:42, Liam Foster <liam.foster@skylineexpos.com> wrote:
> > The official rigging limit for that run is 8ft vertical height...

- We can accept the 8ft vertical banners instead of the 12ft horizontal band. Please confirm the exact mount points so our vendor can design bleed and hems accordingly.
- Priya: can you confirm the crate dimensions include skids (crate_manifest_q3.csv) — I want to reserve the 08:00–08:20 unload slot if possible. If the crate needs the freight elevator, we'll need the elevator booking number (Liam note).
- Alex: can you get a preliminary sign quote from AR Exhibits for two 3.3ft x 8ft tension banners + a 3ft countertop header? Include installation labor and any show-time rigging fees.

We'll also need to flag ADA clearance for the demo area and ensure our demo volunteers aren't staged in the main aisle during peak hours. I'll put this on the expo runbook and assign an on-floor owner.

Marissa Cole
Events Ops Lead, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
